question: Which of the following is one of the objectives of the 'Swadesh Darshan 2.0 Scheme'?

options.text: To provide vocational training to youth
To enhance the contribution of farming
To increase private sector investment in tourism and hospitality
To promote local art and culture handicrafts and cuisines etc.

solution:
The correct answer is __**To increase private sector investment in tourism and hospitality.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The objective of the **'Swadesh Darshan 2.0 Scheme**' is to increase** private sector investment** in tourism and hospitality.
 
• The scheme aims to develop theme-based** tourist circuits **and promote **tourism infrastructure** in the country.
 
• The focus is on developing and promoting lesser-known destinations and creating employment opportunities in the **tourism sector.**
 
• **'Swadesh Darshan 2.0 Scheme'** is a part of the government's larger initiative to boost tourism in India, which includes the** 'Atithi Devo Bhava'** campaign and the **'Incredible India'** campaign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of Tourism** initiated the **"National Mission on Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Augmentation Drive** (PRASAD)" in 2014–15 with the goal of **developing pilgrimage** locations holistically.
 
• The PRASHAD Scheme aims to enhance the religious tourism experience by identifying and developing **pilgrimage sites **throughout India.
 
• In order to offer a comprehensive religious** tourism experience,** it seeks to integrate pilgrimage sites in a **planned, sustainable, and prioritized manner.**
